helpCenter.title: Help Center
helpCenter.subtitle: Find answers, manage your account, and get support without the confusion.
helpCenter.card1Desc: Use the help center to quickly understand listings, OTP login, profile updates, and seller contact steps.
helpCenter.card2Desc: If something is urgent, move straight to WhatsApp support and talk to the team faster.
helpCenter.card3Desc: We keep help simple, practical, and focused on what matters most while using the app.
helpCenter.quickActionsTitle: Get help with the most common tasks
helpCenter.actionSellDesc: Open the listing flow and post a new animal for sale with photos, details, and price.
helpCenter.actionProfileDesc: Update your name, address, location, and account details from your profile page.
helpCenter.actionSupportDesc: Reach our support team on WhatsApp if you need help with login, listings, or app issues.
helpCenter.whatsappCtaDesc: Best for urgent issues, login trouble, or listing-related help.
helpCenter.faqSubtitle: Browse the most useful questions below to solve issues faster without waiting for support.
helpCenter.q1: How do I list an animal?
helpCenter.a1: Go to Sell Animal, fill the form, and submit. Your listing will appear after review.
helpCenter.q2: How do I mark my listing as sold?
helpCenter.a2: Open your Profile, go to My Animals, and click Mark Sold on the listing.
helpCenter.q3: Why is my listing not visible?
helpCenter.a3: Check if it is marked Sold, or still under review. Also ensure photos and price are filled.
helpCenter.q4: How do I edit my profile?
helpCenter.a4: Go to Profile and click Edit Profile to update your details.
helpCenter.a5: Check network signal, wait a minute, then tap Resend OTP.
helpCenter.q6: How do I contact a seller?
helpCenter.a6: Open the listing and tap Call or WhatsApp to reach the seller.
helpCenter.stillNeedHelpDesc: Message our support team on WhatsApp.

terms.title: Terms and Conditions
terms.subtitle: Review the rules, responsibilities, and legal conditions that apply when you use Animal E Bazar.
terms.summaryAccessDesc: Accessing the service means you agree to the core terms that govern your use of the platform.
terms.summaryUseDesc: Users are expected to post accurate listings, act responsibly, and avoid fraud or abuse.
terms.summaryUpdatesDesc: We may update these terms and take action on accounts that violate platform rules.
terms.contactCardDesc: If any condition is unclear, our support team can help explain how these terms apply to your use of the app.
terms.overviewTitle: A practical summary of the main terms
terms.overviewBody: These terms explain who can use the platform, what kind of activity is allowed, how listings and content are handled, and when we may suspend or terminate accounts. We present them in a simpler, readable format so you can review them quickly.
terms.s1Body: By accessing or using Animal E Bazar, you agree to these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree, do not use the Service.
terms.s2Body: You must be at least 18 years old and capable of entering a legal contract to use this Service.
terms.s3Body: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account and for all activities under your account.
terms.s4Body: Sellers are responsible for accurate listings. Buyers and sellers communicate directly. We are not a party to any transaction.
terms.s5Item1: Posting false, misleading, or illegal listings
terms.s5Item4: Attempting to disrupt or reverse engineer the Service
terms.s6Body: You own the content you submit. By posting, you grant us a non-exclusive, worldwide, royalty-free license to display and distribute your content to operate the Service.
terms.s7Body: Our branding, logos, and platform design are owned by Animal E Bazar and may not be used without permission.
terms.s8Body: The Service is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind. We do not guarantee uninterrupted or error-free operation.
terms.s9Body: To the maximum extent permitted by law, we are not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages.
terms.s10Body: We may suspend or terminate accounts that violate these Terms.
terms.s11Body: We may update these Terms from time to time. Continued use of the Service means you accept the changes.
terms.s12Body: For questions or support, please use the WhatsApp support option in your Profile or contact us via your official support channels.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: Understand what information we collect, why we use it, and the choices you have while using Animal E Bazar.
privacy.summaryCollectDesc: Account, listing, usage, and optional location information needed to run the service smoothly.
privacy.summaryUseDesc: To manage accounts, connect buyers and sellers, improve safety, and support core app features.
privacy.summaryControlDesc: You can update profile details, control location access, and request account deletion through support.
privacy.contactCardDesc: If you need clarification about how your data is handled, you can reach our support team directly.
privacy.overviewTitle: A practical summary of how we handle your data
privacy.overviewBody: This policy explains the categories of information we collect, how we use that information to operate the platform, and the controls available to you. We aim to keep this policy clear, concise, and easy to review whenever you need it.
privacy.s1Item1: Account details such as name, phone number, and profile photo
privacy.s1Item2: Listing data such as animal details, price, images, and location
privacy.s1Item3: Usage data such as device type and app interactions
privacy.s1Item4: Location data if you enable location services
privacy.s2Item2: Show listings and connect buyers and sellers
privacy.s2Item3: Improve safety, detect abuse, and prevent fraud
privacy.s3Body: We may share necessary data with other users to complete a transaction, with trusted service providers, or when required by law. We do not sell your personal data.
privacy.s4Body: If you allow location services, we may use your location to show nearby listings. Calls made through the app may be logged for safety and analytics purposes.
privacy.s5Body: We retain your information as long as necessary to provide the Service or as required by law.
privacy.s6Body: We use reasonable safeguards to protect your data, but no system is fully secure.
privacy.s7Item1: Update or delete your profile information
privacy.s7Item2: Disable location access in device settings
privacy.s7Item3: Request account deletion by contacting support
privacy.s8Body: This Service is not intended for users under 18 years of age.
privacy.s9Body: We may update this policy from time to time. Continued use of the Service means you accept the updated policy.
privacy.s10Body: For privacy questions, please use the WhatsApp support option in your Profile or contact us via your official support channels.
